units.source_text: 金字塔、狮身人面像、木乃伊以及埃及艳后克里奥佩特拉——

en.t: The pyramids, the Sphinx, mummies, and Cleopatra, the queen of Egypt—

units.source_text: 关于埃及，恐怕很多人只知道这些，而不知道这个国家的妇女们悲惨的婚姻生活吧。

en.t: When it comes to Egypt, many people probably know only these things, and know nothing of the miserable married lives of the women of that country.

units.source_text: 她们像活生生地被埋进坟墓里的木乃伊一样。

en.t: They are like mummies buried alive in tombs.

units.source_text: 她们脸色苍白，被幽禁在永远不见天日的监狱里——

en.t: Their faces are pale, and they are shut away in a prison that will never see the light of day—

units.source_text: 这绝不是夸大其词，完全是她们的实际情况。

en.t: This is by no means an exaggeration; it is exactly their real situation.

units.source_text: 她们当中最先觉醒者的团体“妇女十字军”，为了争取现在才认为是理所当然的一夫一妻制的幸福，甚至必须浴血奋战。

en.t: The Women's Crusade, a group formed by the first among them to awaken, even had to fight through bloodshed to win the happiness of monogamy, which is only now regarded as natural.

units.source_text: 数千年来，埃及的妇女就是在这种恶习下受尽了凌辱。

en.t: For thousands of years, the women of Egypt suffered every humiliation under this corrupt custom.
